candidates.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE polished logo concept presentation for a minimal personal CV editor and public resume website. Candidate A, exact brand text "简屿" and "Janyu", small top-left label "A". A distinctive very simple geometric symbol combining a folded vertical paper page, an understated letter J, and an island-like silhouette. Quiet confident contemporary identity, deep teal #146B62, warm white #FAF9F6, charcoal. Flat precise vector-like geometry, negative space, no gradients, no shadows, no realistic paper texture, no illustration landscape. Elegant custom geometric sans serif Latin wordmark and clean Chinese sans. Landscape brand board: generous whitespace, large primary icon-plus-wordmark centered in upper 65%; lower strip has the SAME symbol in monochrome black on white, white on teal square, and tiny favicon-scale preview, separated by ample whitespace.
